Theorem
[Pointwise $1/4$-pinched manifolds are space forms] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0386 1. appD:D.10\group Ricci Flow Convergence

If a closed Riemannian manifold satisfies $K_{\min }(x)>\frac14K_{\max }(x)>0$ at every point, then it is diffeomorphic to a spherical space form and admits a metric of constant positive sectional curvature.
